name: Cowboybåten
overview: Dick Bewarp is the man who moved to Jämtland and built a huge cowboy hut all alone. But now he wants to do something together with the other villagers and they decide to build the cowboy boat, a giant raft with paddle wheels that will attract tourists with dancing and pirate trips around Lake Mårdsjön. For a year, we follow Dick and the villagers as they turn a "crazy" idea into a finished raft.
